instructions: Path of Building (PoE1) through PobTools. Every number comes from Path of Building's own calculation. The server works on ONE build in a private sandbox: load_build or new_build first, change it with the tools, read numbers with build_summary, and hand the result to the user with export_code (a share code they paste into Path of Building). Nothing is ever written to the user's own Path of Building folder. Use what_if to compare changes without keeping them. Names come in English (name) and Traditional Chinese (nameZh); arguments accept either. DPS depends heavily on the configuration (enemy type, charges, buffs): check get_config before trusting it. Rare items are calculated exactly as written, whether or not they could be crafted in game.

tools.name: load_build
tools.description: Load a build into the sandbox from a Path of Building share code, a build URL (pobb.in, poe.ninja, pastebin...), or a file name returned by list_my_builds. Replaces the current build. Returns a summary.

source.description: Share code, URL, or Builds-relative .xml file name

tools.name: list_my_builds
tools.description: List the builds saved in the user's Path of Building (read-only copy).

tools.name: new_build
tools.description: Start an empty level-1 build for a class and optional ascendancy. Replaces the current build.

tools.name: export_code
tools.description: Export the current build as a Path of Building share code for the user to import.

tools.name: build_summary
tools.description: Class, ascendancy, level, passive points, main skill and about 40 key numbers (life, EHP, max hits, DPS, resistances, defences, mana) of the current build.

tools.name: stat_breakdown
tools.description: Path of Building's breakdown of one number (where it comes from), as text lines. stat is a key from build_summary.stats.

tools.name: check_build
tools.description: Rule-based health check of the current build (resistances, life pool, hit chance, mana sustain, defence layers, utility skills). Returns issues with severity error/warning/info.

tools.name: tree_summary
tools.description: Allocated passive count, keystones, notables and jewel sockets (with the jewel in each).

tools.name: suggest_nodes
tools.description: Unallocated passives ranked by Path of Building's node power for offence or defence (slow on big builds: up to a minute). pathDist is the points needed to reach the node.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Find passive nodes by name or stat text (English or Chinese). Returns ids for allocate_nodes.

tools.name: allocate_nodes
tools.description: Allocate passive nodes by id; the shortest path to each is allocated too, as in Path of Building. A mastery needs its effect id in masteries.

tools.name: deallocate_nodes
tools.description: Deallocate passive nodes by id (nodes that depended on them are removed too, as in Path of Building).

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Socket groups with their gems, levels and qualities, and which group is the main skill.

tools.name: search_gems
tools.description: Find skill or support gems by part of the name (English or Chinese).

support.description: true = supports only, false = actives only

tools.name: set_skill_group
tools.description: Replace the gems of socket group `index`, or add a new group when index is omitted. main=true makes it the main skill.

slot.description: Item slot the gems are socketed in, e.g. Body Armour

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Equipped items per slot, with their full item text.

tools.name: search_uniques
tools.description: Find unique items by name (English or Chinese), optionally filtered by item type (e.g. Ring, Body Armour). Returns item text usable with equip_item.

tools.name: list_bases
tools.description: Item bases (for writing rare items), filtered by name and/or type.

tools.name: equip_item
tools.description: Create an item from text (Path of Building / game copy format: 'Rarity: Rare', name, base, mod lines) and equip it, into `slot` or the first slot it fits.

tools.name: unequip_item
tools.description: Empty an item slot (slot name as in list_items).

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Configuration options that apply to this build (enemy, charges, buffs, conditions) with current values and choices.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Set one configuration option by key (from get_config). Booleans for checkboxes, numbers for counts, a choice value for lists.

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Apply a list of changes, return key numbers before/after and the difference, then restore the build exactly. Allowed tools: allocate_nodes, deallocate_nodes, set_skill_group, equip_item, unequip_item, set_config.
